subject: Eclipse SUMO traffic feasibility for CHOOGuard
scope: Read-only official documentation and local command availability; no installation or simulation run

supports: vClass=emergency behavior and rescue vehicle model

fit.osm_to_network: YES: netconvert directly accepts OSM XML via --osm-files and emits .net.xml; this matches the repository's asset-library/space-references/busan-reconstruction/osm-busan-map.xml.
fit.directed_route_station_return: YES: SUMO routes are edge sequences and TraCI can add/control vehicles; station/return orchestration remains CHOOGuard-side scenario logic.
fit.fixed_speed_8mps: YES: define a vType maxSpeed=8 and use TraCI/route controls; SUMO may still apply car-following and junction constraints.
fit.one_second_stepping: YES: TraCI advances only when the client issues simulationStep; configure step-length 1s and call it once per Unity tick/bridge cycle.
fit.emergency_vehicle: YES: vClass=emergency is built in, including rescue shape and special lane/overtaking permissions; it is not a calibrated emergency-response model.
fit.unity_integration: PRACTICAL via a local SUMO process plus TraCI TCP or libsumo; bridge ownership and time synchronization are implementation decisions for Astra.

install_options.recommended: Official macOS pkg from Downloads page; install Python/XQuartz as needed. The Downloads page explicitly says Homebrew bottles are discouraged and no longer maintained.
install_options.python_wheel: After the standard macOS dependencies are installed: python3 -m venv .venv-sumo; . .venv-sumo/bin/activate; pip install eclipse-sumo. The official page says macOS wheels are available, but dependencies must first be installed/up to date.
install_options.legacy_or_secondary: brew tap dlr-ts/sumo && brew install sumo (official Installing page documents it, while Downloads page warns it is no longer maintained).

recipe_for_existing_osm.TraCI_smoke: Connect to localhost:8813, load a route/vehicle with vClass=emergency and maxSpeed=8, then issue simulationStep() once per second; close the connection when the route completes.
recipe_for_existing_osm.local_run_status: NOT_RUN: sumo and netconvert are absent locally; this artifact records a reproducible post-install recipe rather than claiming generated output.

limits: OSM geometry, lane permissions, and guessed signals are map-derived/heuristic; they do not establish surveyed geometry or observed traffic fidelity.
No observed traffic counts, travel-time distributions, signal timing validation, incident logs, or emergency response calibration are present in this check.
SUMO emergency permissions do not prove real-world driver yielding, dispatch behavior, or CHOOGuard product acceptance.
The current local check did not install packages, generate a network, open Unity, or validate a TraCI bridge.
recommendation: USEFUL NEXT, NON-BLOCKING: SUMO is a credible optional traffic digital-twin lane for later route/time/traffic experiments and can consume the existing OSM XML. Keep the current Unity agency core moving; add SUMO only behind a small local bridge spike with explicit synchronization and calibration gates.
